subject: Request: pilot stipend / trial credits for BrightPath data privatization project
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina@brightpath.org>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot request: privacy-preserving transcript anonymization (BrightPath)

Hi Ava,

Thanks for taking a look — I run programs at BrightPath Education, a small nonprofit that builds anonymized tutoring datasets for low-income school districts. We're starting a 3-month pilot with State University (Prof. Daniel Kim) to test a privacy-preserving transcript anonymization pipeline and would love to evaluate Redwood Inference for run-of-pipeline inference and on-prem token limits.

High-level asks:
- Short trial extension (90 days) and a stipend/credit of about 40k token-equivalent to cover initial experiments.
- Confirm data residency options (US-only) and KMS support for keys.
- A brief MOU for nonprofit pilots so our procurement team can approve access.

I've attached a draft MOU and a short data-retention spreadsheet. We can provide a redacted sample of transcripts and an IRB cover note. Can you advise next steps and whether a nonprofit promo applies?

Appreciate it — hope we can move quickly, pilot kicks off mid-April.

Best,
Lina Torres
Program Director, BrightPath Education
Attachment: BrightPath_MOU_Draft.pdf

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Lina Torres <lina@brightpath.org>
Date: 2028-03-22T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot request: privacy-preserving transcript anonymization (BrightPath)

Ben/Marissa — forwarding a nonprofit pilot request from BrightPath. They need a 90-day extension and ~40k token-equivalent credits for a research pilot with State University. They also asked about US-only residency and KMS. I've attached their MOU draft.

Can we confirm what we can offer under the nonprofit program (accelerated onboarding, pilot credits, any legal template) and what technical guardrails we should recommend? Lina, looping you in so you see internal owners.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Enterprise Partnerships (Education)
Redwood Inference
Attachment: BrightPath_MOU_Draft.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Lina Torres <lina@brightpath.org>
Date: 2028-03-23T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request: privacy-preserving transcript anonymization (BrightPath)

Thanks Ava — Lina, great to meet you. Quick note on what we can typically do for small nonprofits running IRB-backed pilots:

- Pilot stipend: we can provision a one-time credit package equivalent to 40k token usage and extend the trial period to 90 days.
- Procurement: we'll need an MOU or simple SOW and a procurement contact (we can do a simplified purchase order if needed).
- Compliance docs: I'll attach links to our SOC2 and KMS whitepaper in HubSpot; Marissa, please confirm the KMS and data-residency ops.

If that sounds good, Lina, please share the procurement contact and preferred billing/legal flow. We can provision the credits once the MOU/SOW is signed or with a countersigned email from procurement for smaller orgs.

Also, tagging Neha to confirm any promo codes for non-profit partners we can apply.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Sales, Education & Nonprofit Programs
Redwood Inference
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/BR-9876

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Lina Torres <lina@brightpath.org>
Date: 2028-03-24T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request: privacy-preserving transcript anonymization (BrightPath)

Hi all — quick tech/ops notes from the solutions side:

- Data residency & KMS: we support US-only keying and can restrict processing to our US regions for this workload. KMS integration will require a short onboarding step; we can share the integration checklist.
- Cost/throughput estimate: from similar pilots, anonymizing redacted transcripts (avg 1,200 tokens per student record) at 2k records/day would be ~2.4M tokens/month; 40k covers initial model-probing and prompt tuning only. If they expect larger throughput, we should propose a staged quota with autoscaling on Dedicated or burst credits.
- Recommended config: enable prefix caching for consistent prompts, and use our quantized model variants to reduce per-token cost.

Please see attached retention/fields spreadsheet — Lina, if you can fill the sample sizes and a small redacted example schema that will help us size the environment.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
Attachment: BrightPath_Data_Retention_Reqs.xlsx

From: Lina Torres <lina@brightpath.org>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-01T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request: privacy-preserving transcript anonymization (BrightPath)

Ava/Ben/Marissa — thank you, this is very helpful. We accept the 90-day extension and the 40k credit stipend. Our procurement lead is on copy: procurement@brightpath.org (Rachel Owens). She can countersign the MOU or send a PO — whichever is faster.

Quick answers:
- We will provide a redacted sample schema by EOD tomorrow and an IRB cover note.
- Expected pilot throughput is lower than Marissa's conservative estimate (closer to 300k tokens/month for month 1 while we tune prompts), but we appreciate the scaling guidance.

Request: can the credits be provisioned once Rachel sends a countersigned MOU or a procurement email? We ideally need onboarding within 48–72 hours of that handshake to meet our mid-April start.

On another note, Prof. Daniel Kim will join the kickoff call and loop in State University IT for data handling questions.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Lina Torres
Program Director, BrightPath Education
procurement@brightpath.org
